project.name: KenGranderson.com
project.description: Ken Granderson's personal website: a static site (legacy pages plus a Vite + React site pre-rendered to HTML) published to Bluehost shared hosting by GitHub Actions on every merge to master.

notes: Ken's repositories live under %USERPROFILE%\source\repos on Windows (blackfacts/tools is cloned there as Wakanda.Tools).
Any folder works: the tools find sibling repositories relative to this repository unless -WorkspaceRoot is given.

repositories.name: kengranderson
repositories.purpose: The website: content (JSON), legacy pages, React site in web/, build script, deploy workflow.
repositories.access: public (read); write: Ken (kengranderson) and collaborators he adds

repositories.name: tools
repositories.purpose: Wakanda Tools: the shared deploy action (vendored here in .wakanda/shared-hosting-deploy), deploy-key setup, custom-domain cutover, and these workstation-readiness tools. Not needed to edit or build the site.

install.windows: winget install --id Git.Git -e (or launcher\Install-WakandaTools.cmd from blackfacts/tools)
Install Git for Windows (winget install --id Git.Git -e); it includes Git Bash. WSL's bash is not used.
Install Python 3 from the Microsoft Store (it provides python3.exe); the python.org installer only provides python/py

tools.name: GitHub CLI
tools.purpose: deploy-key setup (blackfacts/tools Setup-DeployKey.ps1) and pull requests from the command line

tools.name: OpenSSH client
tools.purpose: only for one-time deploy setup against Bluehost; normal deploys run in GitHub Actions

install.windows: Settings > Optional features > OpenSSH Client (built into Windows 10/11)

tools.name: PowerShell 7
tools.purpose: recommended for the blackfacts/tools scripts (Windows PowerShell 5.1 also runs the readiness tools)

manual.description: A GitHub account with write access to kengranderson/kengranderson (to push branches and open pull requests).
manual.howToVerify: gh auth status; then gh repo view kengranderson/kengranderson

manual.description: Read access to the private blackfacts/tools repository (deploy setup, refreshing the vendored deploy action, these readiness tools).
Merging to master publishes the site. Only Ken (or someone he authorizes) merges.
SSH access to the Bluehost account, only to (re)create the deploy key. Day-to-day deploys need nothing on the workstation.
Playwright with Chromium for the heading fit check (npm run check:fit in web/). Not in package.json; install separately.

environmentVariables.name: SITE_MODE
environmentVariables.purpose: preview (default: drafts and VERIFY flags shown, pages noindex) or production (published records only).

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_HOST
environmentVariables.purpose: Bluehost SSH host; GitHub environment bluehost-preview variable.

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_PATH
environmentVariables.purpose: Site folder on Bluehost, relative to the SSH home; environment variable.

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: URL the deploy verifies; environment variable.

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_VERIFY_INSECURE
environmentVariables.purpose: true only while the site has no valid certificate.

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_SSH_KEY
environmentVariables.purpose: Private deploy key for this site only (created by Setup-DeployKey.ps1).

environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS
environmentVariables.purpose: Pinned SSH host key of the Bluehost server.

services.name: GitHub
services.purpose: Source, pull requests and the deploy workflow.

build.name: build and check the site into _site
build.verified: linux 2026-10-27 (Node 22.22.0, Python 3.13): 894 files, 0 warnings; GitHub Actions on every merge

test.name: heading fit check (needs Playwright + Chromium)
test.verified: added in PR #5 (2026-10-26); run on linux 2026-10-27 in this session only if noted in docs/status.md; not run on Windows (the script builds paths from import.meta.url pathname, which may not resolve on Windows)

smoke.name: built home page and highlights exist
project records present (My Work pages)
smoke.verified: linux 2026-10-27: FAILS, the records were never committed (see docs/status.md)

start.name: serve the built site at http://localhost:8080

knownLimitations: The build has run on Linux (GitHub Actions and a cloud session). It has not yet been run on Windows: scripts/build-site.sh needs Git Bash and a python3 command there.
There is no live-reload dev server; rebuild with scripts/build-site.sh and refresh.

Legacy: generatejson/ (a .NET Framework console app) once generated KenGranderson/highlights.json from a SQL Server database 'KenGranderson' on the machine INKOSI. The JSON file is now edited directly; running generatejson would overwrite those edits. Not needed for development.
